must_contain: The link token is requested with POST /api/hiecm/v3/token/generate-token.
That call returns only 202 Accepted, and the linkToken arrives later on your bridge at /api/v3/hip/token/on-generate-token.
notes: A real question from the live Ask AI panel that failed there, kept in the reader's exact words. The miss a wrong answer makes is expecting the token in the response body.
